wiz.title: Setup
wiz.settingsNote: Games, language, look and what to set up per game. Changes show up in each game's History.
wiz.found: TM Horizon found {n} games on this PC.
wiz.foundNote: Missing one? Settings > Folders has Scan drives and Add folder.
wiz.pick: Pick what to set up. Nothing is changed before Apply.
wiz.what.tmloader: Loads mods for Nations and United Forever. Its setup opens in its own window.
wiz.what.tmvs: Better light and colours, photo mode and video export.
wiz.what.cp: Fixes and checks that leagues and competitions ask for.
wiz.what.hostForever: In-game menu with modules, as a TMLoader mod.
wiz.what.host: In-game menu with modules (capture, upscaling, packs ...). An existing dinput8.dll is kept and loaded too.
wiz.what.upload: Uploads your own finishes to TMX with the account signed in to TM Horizon.
wiz.what.discord: Shows in Discord which game you play.
wiz.reviewNone: Nothing picked. Go back or skip.
wiz.chains: The existing dinput8.dll ({owner}) is kept and loaded after Horizon Client.
wiz.undoNote: Every file change can be undone in the game's History.
wiz.waitSetup: Waiting for the TMLoader setup window…
wiz.tmlDone: TMLoader installed. Start it once, then mods can go in.
wiz.afterTmlRun: Start TMLoader once, then install it on the Mods page.
wiz.finished: Done. You can open this again in Settings.
